StoredXssComments stores and retrieves user comments. The test file StoredXssCommentsTest tests this functionality. StoredCrossSiteScriptingVerifier is a follow-up assignment that verifies the XSS attack succeeded. Fixing the stored XSS will require updating both the storage mechanism and the verifier logic.

commons-collections 3.2.1 is declared in pom.xml but no Java files in the codebase import or use it directly. This appears to be a transitive dependency. Upgrading the version in pom.xml should not affect any application code.

XStream 1.4.5 is used in VulnerableComponentsLesson to demonstrate deserialization vulnerabilities. The lesson intentionally uses the vulnerable version. Upgrading XStream will break the lesson's educational purpose. The test file also depends on the vulnerable behavior.
